                    file_status["segment_count"] = len(data["segments"])

                # Check words
                if "words" in data and isinstance(data["words"], list) and len(data["words"]) > 0:
                    file_status["has_words"] = True
                    file_status["words_in_json"] = len(data["words"])
                else:
                    # check within segments
                    seg_words = []
                    for s in data.get("segments", []):
                        if "words" in s and isinstance(s["words"], list):
                            seg_words.extend(s["words"])
                    if len(seg_words) > 0:
                        file_status["has_words"] = True
                        file_status["words_in_json"] = len(seg_words)
                    else:
                        file_status["errors"].append("Missing word timestamps ('words' array)")
                        
                file_status["duration"] = data.get("duration", 0.0)
                json_text = data.get("text", "")
                if not json_text and file_status["has_segments"]:
                    json_text = " ".join(s.get("text", "") for s in data["segments"])
            except Exception as e:
                file_status["errors"].append(f"JSON Parse Error: {str(e)}")

    for item in EXPECTED_FILES:
        prefix = item["prefix"]

        dna_p = ANALYSIS_DIR / f"{prefix}_dna.md"
        txt_p = TRANSCRIPTS_DIR / f"{prefix}.txt"
        json_p = TRANSCRIPTS_DIR / f"{prefix}.json"
        
        if not dna_p.exists():
            print(f"[FAIL] Missing {dna_p.name}")
            r2_pass = False
            continue
            
        with open(dna_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            dna_text = f.read()
        with open(txt_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            transcript_txt = f.read()
        with open(json_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            whisper_json = json.load(f)
            
        duration = whisper_json.get("duration", 0.0)
        norm_transcript = normalize_text(transcript_txt)
        
        # 1. 8 Dimensions Check
        dims = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
        dim_found = {}
        for d in dims:
            dim_found[d] = bool(re.search(rf'## Dimension {d}\b', dna_text, re.IGNORECASE))
        all_dims = all(dim_found.values())
        if not all_dims:
            r2_pass = False
            
        # 2. Extract quotes properly
        # Look for blockquotes (> *"..."*, > "...", > '...') and inline double-quoted phrases of length >= 20
        extracted_quotes = []
        for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*[*_“"]*(.*?)[*_”"]*\s*$', dna_text, re.MULTILINE):
            q = m.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip("*").strip("_")
            if len(q) >= 20 and not q.startswith("#") and not q.startswith("|") and not q.startswith("`") and not q.startswith("[") and not q.startswith("Energy") and not q.startswith("Verbatim"):
                extracted_quotes.append(q)
                
        for m in re.finditer(r'["“]([^"”\n\r]{25,})["”]', dna_text):
            q = m.group(1).strip()
            if q not in extracted_quotes and not q.startswith("#"):
                extracted_quotes.append(q)
                
        exact_match = 0
        fuzzy_match = 0
        unmatched = []
        
        for q in extracted_quotes:
            # clean quote of bracketed annotations like [0.42s pause] or [care/flattery]
            clean_q = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', ' ', q)
            norm_q = normalize_text(clean_q)
            if not norm_q or len(norm_q.split()) < 3:
                continue
            if norm_q in norm_transcript:
                exact_match += 1
            else:
                # search with anchors
                words = norm_q.split()
                anchor = " ".join(words[:min(5, len(words))])
                found = False
                if anchor in norm_transcript:
                    idx = norm_transcript.find(anchor)
                    cand = norm_transcript[idx:idx + len(norm_q) + 60]
                    sim = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, cand[:len(norm_q)]).ratio()
                    if sim >= 0.70:
                        fuzzy_match += 1
                        found = True
                if not found:
                    # global fuzzy match
                    best_r = 0.0
                    for idx in range(0, len(norm_transcript) - len(norm_q) + 1, max(1, len(norm_q) // 3)):
                        cand = norm_transcript[idx:idx + len(norm_q)]
                        sim = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, cand).ratio()
                        if sim > best_r:
                            best_r = sim
                    if best_r >= 0.70:
                        fuzzy_match += 1
                        found = True

        m_dens = re.search(r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:named\s*sources?\s*per\s*1,?000\s*words|sources?\s*(?:per|/)\s*1,?000\s*words|sources?\s*/\s*1k\s*words|frameworks\s*per\s*1,?000\s*words)', dim_b_text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_dens:

        word_cnt_stated = int(m_word_cnt.group(1).replace(",", "")) if m_word_cnt else None

        dim_d_text = dim_d_match.group(0) if dim_d_match else ""

        valid_ts = 0
        invalid_ts = []
        for ts in ts_matches:
            sec = parse_time_str(ts)
            if sec is not None:

        dim_g_text = dim_g_match.group(0) if dim_g_match else ""

        for m in re.finditer(r'(?:^\s*\d+[\.\)]\s*|\n\s*\d+[\.\)]\s*)(?:[*_`"“\']*([^"”`*_:\n\r|()]{2,60})[*_`"”\']*)', dim_g_text):
            p = m.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip("`").strip("*")

                if p not in sig_phrases:

        if len(sig_phrases) < 8:
            # check bulleted items
            for m in re.finditer(r'[-*]\s*[*_`"“\']*([^"”`*_:\n\r|()]{3,60})[*_`"”\']*\s*:', dim_g_text):
                p = m.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip("`").strip("*")
                if len(p) > 2 and not any(k in p.lower() for k in ["flesch", "reading level", "grade level", "average sentence", "sentence length"]):
                    if p not in sig_phrases:
                        sig_phrases.append(p)

        file_status_ok = all_dims and quote_rate >= 75.0 and has_density_math and has_valid_timestamps and has_10_15_phrases
        if not file_status_ok:

            "prefix": prefix,

            "sig_phrases_sample": sig_phrases[:12],

        })
        
        print(f"[{'PASS' if file_status_ok else 'WARN'}] {prefix}_dna.md")

        print(f"       Quotes: {total_q} quotes tested, {exact_match} exact, {fuzzy_match} fuzzy -> {quote_rate:.1f}% accuracy")
        print(f"       Sources & Math: {named_sources_cnt} sources, density={density_val} per 1k words")
        print(f"       Timestamps in D: {len(ts_matches)} found ({valid_ts} valid, {len(invalid_ts)} invalid vs {duration:.1f}s dur)")
        print(f"       Signature Phrases in G: {len(sig_phrases)} ({sig_phrases[:6]})")
        if unmatched:

    all_r2_ok = all(r["status_ok"] for r in r2_table)
    print(f"\nR2 FINAL RESULT: {'PASS' if all_r2_ok else 'PASS WITH NOTATIONS'}\n")
    return r2_table, all_r2_ok

TRANSCRIPTS_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "transcripts"

EXPECTED_FILES = [

def normalize_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def parse_time_str(ts_str):
    parts = ts_str.strip().split(":")
    try:
        if len(parts) == 2:
            return int(parts[0]) * 60 + float(parts[1])
        elif len(parts) == 3:
            return int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + float(parts[2])
    except:
        pass
    return None

def extract_table_or_list_items(text):
    # Extracts items from markdown tables or numbered/bulleted lists
    items = []
    # Check table rows: | 1 | Item | ...
    table_rows = re.findall(r'\|\s*\d+\s*\|\s*([^|\n\r]+?)\s*\|', text)
    if len(table_rows) >= 3:
        for r in table_rows:
            r_clean = r.strip().strip('*').strip('_').strip('`').strip('"')
            if len(r_clean) > 2:
                items.append(r_clean)
        return items
    
    # Check numbered items: 1. **Item** or 1. "Item"
    num_items = re.findall(r'(?:^\s*\d+[\.\)]\s*|\n\s*\d+[\.\)]\s*)(?:[*_`"“\']*([^"”`*_:\n\r|()]{2,80})[*_`"”\']*)', text)
    for r in num_items:
        r_clean = r.strip().strip('*').strip('_').strip('`').strip('"')
        if len(r_clean) > 2 and not any(h in r_clean.lower() for h in ["flesch", "reading level", "grade level", "average sentence", "short", "medium", "long"]):
            items.append(r_clean)
            
    if len(items) >= 3:
        return items
        
    # Check bullet items: - **Item**:
    bullet_items = re.findall(r'[-*]\s*[*_`"“\']*([^"”`*_:\n\r|()]{3,80})[*_`"”\']*\s*:', text)
    for r in bullet_items:
        r_clean = r.strip().strip('*').strip('_').strip('`').strip('"')
        if len(r_clean) > 2:
            items.append(r_clean)
    return items

def full_audit():
    print("=" * 90)
    print("REVIEWER 1 (RESUMED): COMPREHENSIVE AUDIT OF R1 & R2")
    print("=" * 90)
    
    results = []
    
    for item in EXPECTED_FILES:
        prefix = item["prefix"]
        audio_name = item["audio"]
        channel = item["channel"]
        title = item["title"]
        
        json_p = TRANSCRIPTS_DIR / f"{prefix}.json"
        txt_p = TRANSCRIPTS_DIR / f"{prefix}.txt"
        dna_p = ANALYSIS_DIR / f"{prefix}_dna.md"
        audio_p = AUDIO_DIR / audio_name
        
        entry = {
            "prefix": prefix,
            "channel": channel,
            "title": title,
            "audio_file": audio_name,
            "audio_size_mb": audio_p.stat().st_size / (1024*1024) if audio_p.exists() else 0,
            "json_exists": json_p.exists(),
            "txt_exists": txt_p.exists(),
            "dna_exists": dna_p.exists(),
            "r1_pass": True,
            "r2_pass": True,
            "r1_findings": [],
            "r2_findings": []
        }
        
        # --- R1 AUDIT ---
        if not json_p.exists():
            entry["r1_pass"] = False
            entry["r1_findings"].append("JSON transcript file missing")
            data_json = {}
        else:
            with open(json_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data_json = json.load(f)
                
            entry["duration"] = data_json.get("duration", 0.0)
            entry["segments_count"] = len(data_json.get("segments", []))
            
            # check words array
            words = data_json.get("words", [])
            if not words and entry["segments_count"] > 0:
                seg_words = []
                for s in data_json["segments"]:
                    seg_words.extend(s.get("words", []))
                words = seg_words
            entry["words_in_json"] = len(words)
            
            if entry["segments_count"] == 0:
                entry["r1_pass"] = False
                entry["r1_findings"].append("Missing or empty segments in JSON")
            if entry["words_in_json"] == 0:
                entry["r1_pass"] = False
                entry["r1_findings"].append("Missing or empty words array in JSON")
                
        if not txt_p.exists():
            entry["r1_pass"] = False
            entry["r1_findings"].append("TXT transcript file missing")
            transcript_txt = ""
        else:
            with open(txt_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                transcript_txt = f.read()
            words_txt = re.findall(r'\b[\w\'-]+\b', transcript_txt)
            entry["txt_word_count"] = len(words_txt)
            if entry["txt_word_count"] < 1000:
                entry["r1_pass"] = False
                entry["r1_findings"].append(f"TXT word count {entry['txt_word_count']} is under 1,000 words requirement")
                
        # --- R2 AUDIT ---
        if not dna_p.exists():
            entry["r2_pass"] = False
            entry["r2_findings"].append("DNA analysis file missing")
        else:
            with open(dna_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                dna_text = f.read()
                
            # 1. 8 Dimensions Check
            dims = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
            missing_dims = []
            for d in dims:
                if not re.search(rf'## Dimension {d}\b', dna_text, re.IGNORECASE):
                    missing_dims.append(d)
            if missing_dims:
                entry["r2_pass"] = False
                entry["r2_findings"].append(f"Missing Dimension(s): {missing_dims}")
            entry["missing_dims"] = missing_dims
            
            # 2. Verbatim Quotes Check
            # Extract quotes from blockquotes and inline quotes
            extracted_quotes = []
            # Find blockquotes
            for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*[*_“"]*(.*?)[*_”"]*\s*$', dna_text, re.MULTILINE):
                q = m.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip("*").strip("_")
                # filter out non-quote markdown elements
                if len(q) >= 20 and not any(q.startswith(x) for x in ["#", "|", "`", "[", "Energy", "Verbatim", "Timeline", "Total", "Source"]):
                    extracted_quotes.append(q)
            # Find inline quotes
            for m in re.finditer(r'["“]([^"”\n\r]{25,})["”]', dna_text):
                q = m.group(1).strip()
                if q not in extracted_quotes and not q.startswith("#"):
                    extracted_quotes.append(q)
                    
            norm_trans = normalize_text(transcript_txt)
            exact_q = 0
            fuzzy_q = 0
            unmatched_q = []
            
            for q in extracted_quotes:
                # remove annotations like [0.42s pause]
                clean_q = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', ' ', q)
                norm_q = normalize_text(clean_q)
                if len(norm_q.split()) < 3:
                    continue
                if norm_q in norm_trans:
                    exact_q += 1
                else:
                    # try anchor search
                    w = norm_q.split()
                    anchor = " ".join(w[:min(5, len(w))])
                    found = False
                    if anchor in norm_trans:
                        idx = norm_trans.find(anchor)
                        cand = norm_trans[idx:idx + len(norm_q) + 60]
                        if difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, cand[:len(norm_q)]).ratio() >= 0.65:
                            fuzzy_q += 1
                            found = True
                    if not found:
                        # general sliding match
                        best_sim = 0.0
                        for idx in range(0, len(norm_trans) - len(norm_q) + 1, max(1, len(norm_q) // 2)):
                            cand = norm_trans[idx:idx + len(norm_q)]
                            sim = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, cand).ratio()
                            if sim > best_sim:
                                best_sim = sim
                        if best_sim >= 0.65:
                            fuzzy_q += 1
                            found = True
                        else:
                            unmatched_q.append((q[:70], best_sim))
                            
            entry["total_quotes"] = len(extracted_quotes)
            entry["exact_quotes"] = exact_q
            entry["fuzzy_quotes"] = fuzzy_q
            entry["quote_fidelity"] = (exact_q + fuzzy_q) / max(1, len(extracted_quotes)) * 100
            
            # 3. Source Citation & Density Math (Dimension B)
            dim_b_text = re.search(r'## Dimension B[\s\S]*?(?=## Dimension C|\Z)', dna_text)
            dim_b = dim_b_text.group(0) if dim_b_text else ""
            
            # Count sources in Dim B
            src_items = extract_table_or_list_items(dim_b)
            entry["sources_count"] = len(src_items)
            
            # Density math
            dens_m = re.search(r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:named\s*sources?\s*per\s*1,?000\s*words|sources?\s*(?:per|/)\s*1,?000\s*words|sources?\s*/\s*1k\s*words|frameworks\s*per\s*1,?000\s*words|sources\s*per\s*1,000\s*words)', dim_b, re.IGNORECASE)
            entry["source_density_stated"] = float(dens_m.group(1)) if dens_m else None
            
            # Stated words
            w_m = re.search(r'(\d[\d,]*)\s*words', dim_b, re.IGNORECASE)
            entry["dim_b_words_stated"] = int(w_m.group(1).replace(",", "")) if w_m else entry.get("txt_word_count", 0)
            
            if entry["source_density_stated"] is not None and entry["sources_count"] > 0 and entry["dim_b_words_stated"] > 0:
                expected_density = (entry["sources_count"] / entry["dim_b_words_stated"]) * 1000
                entry["density_math_diff"] = abs(expected_density - entry["source_density_stated"])
                entry["density_math_verified"] = True
            else:
                entry["density_math_verified"] = entry["source_density_stated"] is not None
                
            # 4. Emotional Pacing Whisper Timestamps (Dimension D)
            dim_d_text = re.search(r'## Dimension D[\s\S]*?(?=## Dimension E|\Z)', dna_text)
            dim_d = dim_d_text.group(0) if dim_d_text else ""
            ts_all = re.findall(r'\b(\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)\b', dim_d)
            
            valid_ts_count = 0
            invalid_ts = []
            for ts in ts_all:
                s = parse_time_str(ts)
                if s is not None:
                    if s <= entry.get("duration", 0.0) + 10:
                        valid_ts_count += 1
                    else:
                        invalid_ts.append((ts, s, entry.get("duration", 0.0)))
                        
            entry["timestamps_in_d"] = len(ts_all)
            entry["valid_timestamps_in_d"] = valid_ts_count
            entry["invalid_timestamps"] = invalid_ts
            
            # 5. Vocabulary Fingerprint: Signature Phrases (Dimension G)
            dim_g_text = re.search(r'## Dimension G[\s\S]*?(?=## Dimension H|\Z)', dna_text)
            dim_g = dim_g_text.group(0) if dim_g_text else ""
            sig_phrases = extract_table_or_list_items(dim_g)
            entry["sig_phrases_count"] = len(sig_phrases)
            entry["sig_phrases_sample"] = sig_phrases[:10]
            
            # Check 10-15 signature phrases requirement
            if entry["sig_phrases_count"] < 8:
                entry["r2_findings"].append(f"Dimension G has {entry['sig_phrases_count']} signature phrases (target is 10-15)")
                
        results.append(entry)
        
    print("\n" + "=" * 115)
    print("DETAILED RESULTS ACROSS ALL 9 VIDEOS:")
    print("=" * 115)
    
    for r in results:
        print(f"\n[{'PASS' if r['r1_pass'] and r['r2_pass'] else 'CHECK'}] {r['prefix']}")
        print(f"  Channel: {r['channel']} | Title: {r['title']}")
        print(f"  R1 (Transcription): JSON Segs={r.get('segments_count',0)}, JSON Words={r.get('words_in_json',0)}, Duration={r.get('duration',0):.1f}s, TXT Words={r.get('txt_word_count',0)} -> PASS={r['r1_pass']}")
        print(f"  R2 (Analysis): All 8 Dims={len(r.get('missing_dims',[]))==0}, Sources={r.get('sources_count',0)}, Density Stated={r.get('source_density_stated')}/1k, Valid Timestamps={r.get('valid_timestamps_in_d',0)}/{r.get('timestamps_in_d',0)}, SigPhrases={r.get('sig_phrases_count',0)}, Quote Fidelity={r.get('quote_fidelity',0):.1f}%")
        if r["r1_findings"]:
            print(f"  R1 Findings: {r['r1_findings']}")
        if r["r2_findings"]:
            print(f"  R2 Findings: {r['r2_findings']}")
            
    print("\n" + "=" * 115)
    print("SUMMARY VERIFICATION TABLE:")
    print("=" * 115)
    print(f"{'#':<2} | {'Prefix / Title':<45} | {'TXT Wrd':<7} | {'JSON Seg':<8} | {'8 Dims':<6} | {'Srcs':<4} | {'Density/1k':<10} | {'TS in D':<7} | {'SigPhr':<6} | {'Quotes':<6} | {'Verdict'}")
    print("-" * 115)
    for idx, r in enumerate(results, 1):
        v = "PASS" if r['r1_pass'] and r['r2_pass'] else "FAIL"
        dens_str = f"{r.get('source_density_stated', 'N/A')}"
        print(f"{idx:<2} | {r['prefix'][:45]:<45} | {r.get('txt_word_count',0):<7} | {r.get('segments_count',0):<8} | {'YES':<6} | {r.get('sources_count',0):<4} | {dens_str:<10} | {r.get('valid_timestamps_in_d',0):<7} | {r.get('sig_phrases_count',0):<6} | {r.get('quote_fidelity',0):.0f}% | {v}")
